This document outlines the 
equipment inspection check list I1, which must be performed every three months 
as indicated by M3 in the title block

The first draft initiated 
by eng. Abdel Hamid Abu Zid, tested by eng. El-Sayed Mahmoud El-Kholy, accepted 
by eng. Sawsan El lithe 
general manager, revised by eng. 
Zakaria El-Shahat 
EDEPC MPIS coordinator and approved by 
eng. Mohamed Hussein Gomaa quality insurance head sector.
A work permit must be issued.

The qualified maintenance 
 staff should carry the suitable ID safety category.

Wear your safety helmet, safety shoes, eye glass, nose mouth dust cover .... 
 etc.
Safety fence with caution marks surrounding the work area is required.
Ensure that the inlet and outlet valve are closed if necessary.

items: A work permit must be issued.

The qualified maintenance 
 staff should carry the suitable ID safety category.

Wear your safety helmet, safety shoes, eye glass, nose mouth dust cover .... 
 etc.
Safety fence with caution marks surrounding the work area is required.
Ensure that the inlet and outlet valve are closed if necessary.
Complete maintenance tool set
Rags, cleaning fluid

Check the oil on oil 
 lubricated units

Check grease 
 lubricated bearings for specifications

Check the packing for 
 leakage and replace if necessary

Check vibration 
 readings of bearing housings

Check alignment of 
 pump and motor
Isolate the electric power before replacing oil or grease, also for repacking

Increase the level oil 
 if oil level decreased and replace the oil if its specifications are not suitable

If the grease gives a 
 whitish color, the grease must be changed and wash the bearing with a suitable 
 industrial solvent cleaner, and replace the grease with the proper type as 
 recommended

If the packing leaks 
 water slightly retight the packing cover bolts gently, and if it still leaks 
 isolate the pump mechanically and electrically, then vent and drain water from 
 inside, and loose the cover bolts

Change the recommended packing and retight the cover 
 bolts, close the drainage valve

Open the suction and discharge 
 valves, then close the vent valve after air bubbles stopped (filled completely with 
 water)

Connect the electric power again and run the pump to 
 check the packing looks (10 minutes)

After ten minutes 
 (Rotation) score vibration readings for bearing housings and compared with the 
 pervious readings

If the alignment 
 checked is not ok - shim up units if necessary

Inspect the piping system unbolt piping at suction 
 and discharge flanges also for supports
Remove rags, tools and other things from the place.
